description: Summarize a saved Terraform plan: deletes and replaces first (with the attribute that forces each replace), updates with changed paths, creates, imports, moves, forgets, drift and output changes, plus a destroy warning that names renames needing a moved block. Pass plan_file (binary from `terraform plan -out`, rendered with `terraform show -json` in dir, or a plan JSON file) or plan_json (e.g. from the official terraform MCP server's get_plan_json_output(plan_id) for an HCP run; get the plan id from its get_run_details). Prints no values: sensitive paths are truncated, import IDs omitted.

dir.description: Terraform root module directory (must already be initialized). Default: TERRAFORM_CWD_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

max_paths.description: Changed attribute paths listed per updated resource (default 8)

plan_file.description: Saved plan (binary from `terraform plan -out`, rendered here with `terraform show -json` in `dir`) or a plan JSON file; relative paths resolve against dir

plan_json.description: Plan JSON text, e.g. from the official terraform MCP server's get_plan_json_output

name: tf_summarize_plan
